message_content: {"issues":[],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-1c65a68b-e7b1-447a-8f6c-f13a20f56e1b-1","verdict":"no_issue","basis":"The claim states the capsule was not ready at 10:00 because its valve cap was loose.
